note: Mostly seasonal: about 55 of its ~150 sites are sold by the night, none of them on the river. Canoe livery on the State Scenic Kokosing River (Ohio's first state water trail). --Claude
summary: Rate confirmed $47.50 (30A, 2 adults + kids). Changed hookups: sewer true -> false ('NO SEWER HOOK-UPS'), added electric 30. Map shows every riverside site is seasonal; transient sites are the 30-amp ones inland. Added showers/flush/dump/laundry/store. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Waterfront downward lead: stored 'riverfront', but the park's own map marks every site along the Kokosing River seasonal (yellow), and the old note already said 'Riverfront sites reserved for full-season campers'. The ~55 transient (30-amp) sites sit one row back or further inland (Areas A/B/C). Re-audit; likely river *view* at best for a transient camper.
